title: epigynium rotundifolium
intro: Epigynium rotundifolium, commonly known as Round-leaved Epigynum, is a type of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues.
